answer: Bindings are kept in saffron, verified in ember, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the thread check. A farm of 587 identities would post 4654 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
